page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top above the text. Below the text: a centred italic quotation line, then the last paragraph line with a large italic opening word. Gathering signature and catchword at the foot. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Scholarum, Academiarum & doctorum ferventiora & petulantiora ingenia coguntur disputare, non credere, opinari, non scire, digladiari, non addiscere, quae scitu necessaria sunt; & tantum non seculum sufficiat spinosarum quaestionum strophas litigiosas detegere, tricas involutissimas enodare, sophismata viscata diluere, imposituras Dædaleas explicare. At vero immortales, per nos, ferant disceptationes, si non impetiginosos, in Dei providentiam, & gratiam efficacem, calamos strinxissent. At quis vere Christianus, se non multis nominibus devinctum fateretur divinae gratiae? de qua, si simul actum & conclamatum sit, totam Theologiam in extrema regula stare, nemo non scit. Nimis exploratum habeo communem, & decantatam Arminiana scholae cantilenam esse, nostrum decretum absolutum, & gratiam Dei irresistibili vi operantem, esse ipsissimum fatum. At probare, causam dicite, tabulas proferre

p.i: Quis tulerit Gracchos de seditione querentes?

main_text.p: Nam sophistae ita argutanti: Quod ego jam

page.notes: Small marks in the margins (a tick at the left beside "irresistibili", a dot at the right beside "de qua") look like ornaments or show-through, not printed notes, so they are left out. The catchword reads "fum" in the scan, most likely "jam"; marked [?]. Signature "* 3" transcribed as "*3". The "Q" of "Quod" is a larger italic ornamental letter.
